div.div:
Key Difference: Flow Matching (pi0)
- Actions generated via iterative denoising (not AR tokens)
- PaliGemma VLM provides rich multi-modal context
- Action chunks: predict H future steps at once
- Flow log-probability replaces discrete logprobs in PPO
- Naturally outputs continuous actions (no binning)
SFT checkpoint: rlinf-pi0-sft-spatial
(pre-trained on LIBERO-Spatial demonstrations)
